concerns.text: Consumer‑before‑producer: T009 (contract test for ingest.py) is listed before its producer T011 (implementation of ingest.py). The test cannot run until the script exists.
Consumer‑before‑producer: T010 (timeout‑handler unit test) precedes its producer T013 (baseline_runner implementation). The test depends on code that does not yet exist.
Consumer‑before‑producer: T017 (tree‑sitter unit test) is placed before T019 (extract_features implementation) which provides the functionality under test.
Consumer‑before‑producer: T018 (fallback‑metrics unit test) appears before T019, the script that generates the structural metrics it validates.
Consumer‑before‑producer: T023 (model‑training unit test) is scheduled before T028 (train_model implementation), so the test would fail due to missing code.
Consumer‑before‑producer: T024 (threshold‑sweep integration test) is listed before T028, the script that produces the threshold_sweep.json it expects.
